SIKAMENT® ECO WR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikament® ECO WR, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikament_eco_wr.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikament® ECO WR where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikament® ECO WR is a mid-range water reducer specifically formulated to produce concrete with improved water reduction . Sikament® ECO WR combines the benefits of normal water reducer and high range water reducer with controlled ease on achieving and maintaining 120-160 mm slumps.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikament® ECO WR is suitable to produce high performance concrete. It helps in greater water reduction, flowability and less “sticky” concrete. The following types of concrete can use Sikament® ECO WR
    - Reinforced, precast, prestressed, lightweight, normal weight or pumped concrete.
    - Concrete, where higher reduced water contents with easy of placing and working with tools is needed.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikament® ECO WR
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Mid-range Water Reducer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sikament® ECO WR meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Mid Range Water Reducer (MWR).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Use of Sikament® ECO WR in concrete improves the following properties.
    - Higher water reduction achieved, results in high density more impermeable concrete.
    - Normal setting at higher doses compared with other water reducers.
    - Improved shrinkage and creep behaviour.
    - Increased Ultimate Strength Performance.
    - Improved plastic concrete properties.
    - Increases service life of structures.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of modified polycarboxylates
    - Appearance and colour: Purple liquid
    - Density: 1.03 g/cm³approximately
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries, 1000 litre IBC, 205 litre drum, 10 litre container.
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperature between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sikament® ECO WR can be used in conjuction with all Sika Concrete Admixtures, except Sikament® NN.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage for general concrete production is between 400-1000 ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on site condition, job conditions, mix ingredients and desired plastic and hardened properties. Laboratory and field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
4.4 Dispensing. Add Sikament® ECO WR to the batching water. For best result, we recommend thorough mixing of wet concrete at 60 seconds per cubic metre of concrete. Add the remaining gauging water progressively after at least 2/3 wet mixing time to achieve the desired consistency.
4.5 Further information.
    - May slightly increase air content of concrete when used at normal dose.
    - Do not use with naphthalene-based admixtures. May experience erratic slump changes.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikament® ECO WR, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikament_eco_wr.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikament Eco WR, version 25/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/MSDS%20Sikament%C2%AE%20Eco%20WR%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikament® ECO WR, version 10/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sds-sikament-ecowr.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
